cases.description: Task scope check (Checklist item 1) correctly fails: the task description is empty, so there is nothing to score keywords against. The engine produces no recommendations and an explicit warning rather than fabricating a plausible-looking file list from no real signal — the right behavior here is abstaining, not guessing.
cases.grounding: report.py: task_description.strip() is falsy, so build_report appends the 'Task description is empty' warning and never enters the per-file scoring loop (keywords is [] via extract_keywords('')).
